title: From a public Sketchfab model to a usable 3D file

nodes.label: Read public viewer
nodes.note: src/lib/pipeline.js: downloadModel; src/lib/sf-api.js: fetchViewerInfo. Entry from a model page, card or collection; requests are anonymous.

nodes.label: Decode mesh
nodes.note: src/lib/pipeline.js: extractStaticKey, decryptBinzBytes, extraAnimationUrls. The viewer script supplies the static key; viewer data supplies diter.b and encrypted file URLs. Animation keyframes are fetched when available.

nodes.label: Descramble textures
nodes.note: src/lib/pipeline.js: fetchTextures and packOrmMaps. maxTextureEdge selects original/4096/2048; ORM combines material channels. This is asset flow, not parallel execution.

nodes.label: Build glTF
nodes.note: src/lib/pipeline.js: convertOsgjsToGlbFromFiles. Uses decoded meshes, textures, viewer materials and optional viewer camera/lights.

nodes.label: glTF ZIP
nodes.note: src/lib/pipeline.js: packGltfFiles. Contains model.gltf, model.bin and textures/.
